title: द्व्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 202 · Sunda and Upasunda conquer the worlds

summary.en: The brothers lead their armies to conquer heaven, earth and the nether worlds. They torment the sages, scatter their sacred fires and slaughter Brahmins, until the three worlds are desolate and they settle at Kurukshetra.
summary.kn: ಸಹೋದರರು ಸೈನ್ಯದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸ್ವರ್ಗ, ಭೂಮಿ, ಪಾತಾಳಗಳನ್ನು ಜಯಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಋಷಿಗಳನ್ನು ಪೀಡಿಸಿ ಅಗ್ನಿಹೋತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಚೆಲ್ಲಾಡಿ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣರನ್ನು ಕೊಲ್ಲುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಮೂರು ಲೋಕಗಳು ಹಾಳಾದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುರುಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ನೆಲೆಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: भाई अपनी सेनाएँ लेकर स्वर्ग, पृथ्वी और पाताल को जीत लेते हैं। वे ऋषियों को सताते, उनकी अग्नियाँ बिखेरते और ब्राह्मणों का वध करते हैं, यहाँ तक कि तीनों लोक उजड़ जाते हैं और वे कुरुक्षेत्र में बस जाते हैं।
summary.te: సోదరులు సైన్యాలతో స్వర్గం, భూమి, పాతాళాలను జయిస్తారు. ఋషులను పీడించి వారి అగ్నులను చెల్లాచెదురు చేసి బ్రాహ్మణులను సంహరిస్తారు; మూడు లోకాలు నిర్జనమైన తర్వాత కురుక్షేత్రంలో స్థిరపడతారు.
summary.ta: சகோதரர்கள் படைகளுடன் ஸ்வர்க்கம், பூமி, பாதாளம் அனைத்தையும் வெல்கிறார்கள். முனிவர்களை வதைத்து அவர்கள் வேள்வித் தீகளைச் சிதறடித்து அந்தணர்களைக் கொல்கிறார்கள்; மூவுலகும் பாழானபின் குருக்ஷேத்திரத்தில் தங்குகிறார்கள்.
summary.ml: സഹോദരന്മാർ സൈന്യവുമായി സ്വർഗത്തെയും ഭൂമിയെയും പാതാളലോകങ്ങളെയും കീഴടക്കാൻ പുറപ്പെടുന്നു. ഋഷിമാരെ പീഡിപ്പിക്കുകയും പുണ്യാഗ്നികൾ ചിതറിക്കുകയും ബ്രാഹ്മണരെ കൊല്ലുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു; മൂന്നു ലോകങ്ങളും ശൂന്യമാകുന്നതുവരെ അവർ കുരുക്ഷേത്രത്തിൽ തങ്ങുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 1.202; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Aug 22 2026

verses.text: नारद उवाच

meaning.en: Narada said:

verses.text:
उत्सवे वृत्तमात्रे तु त्रैलोक्याकाङ्क्षिणावुभौ ।
मन्त्रयित्वा ततः सेनां तावाज्ञापयतां तदा ॥

meaning.en: As soon as the festival was over, the two, longing for the three worlds, took counsel and then ordered their army to march.

verses.text:
सुहृद्भिरभ्यनुज्ञातौ दैत्यवृद्धैश्च मन्त्रिभिः ।
कृत्वा प्रास्थानिकं रात्रौ मघासु ययतुस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: With the leave of their friends, the elder Daityas and their ministers, they performed the rites for departure and set out by night under the Maghas.

verses.text:
गदापट्टिशधारिण्या शूलमुद्गरहस्तया ।
प्रस्थितौ सहधर्मिण्या महत्या दैत्यसेनया ॥

meaning.en: They went forth with a great Daitya army, their loyal companion, bearing maces and swords, spears and clubs.

verses.text:
मङ्गलैः स्तुतिभिश्चापि विजयप्रतिसंहितैः ।
चारणैः स्तूयमानौ तु जग्मतुः परया मुदा ॥

meaning.en: Praised by bards with auspicious hymns that promised victory, they went in supreme joy.

verses.text:
तावन्तरिक्षमुत्पत्य दैत्यौ कामगमावुभौ ।
देवानामेव भवनं जग्मतुर्युद्धदुर्मदौ ॥

meaning.en: Rising into the sky, those two Daityas, able to go where they wished and maddened for battle, came to the very dwelling of the gods.

verses.text:
तयोरागमनं ज्ञात्वा वरदानं च तत्प्रभोः ।
हित्वा त्रिविष्टपं जग्मुर्ब्रह्मलोकं ततः सुराः ॥

meaning.en: Learning of their coming, and of the boon their lord had given them, the gods left heaven and went to the world of Brahma.

verses.text:
ताविन्द्रलोकं निर्जित्य यक्षरक्षोगणांस्तथा ।
खेचराण्यपि भूतानि जिग्यतुस्तीव्रविक्रमौ ॥

meaning.en: Having conquered the realm of Indra, the two of fierce valor also overcame the hosts of yakshas and rakshasas and the beings that move through the air.

verses.text:
अन्तर्भूमिगतान्नागाञ्जित्वा तौ च महासुरौ ।
समुद्रवासिनः सर्वान्म्लेच्छजातीन्विजिग्यतुः ॥

meaning.en: Those two great asuras then conquered the Nagas who lived beneath the earth, and all the barbarian peoples dwelling by the sea.

verses.text:
ततः सर्वां महीं जेतुमारब्धावुग्रशासनौ ।
सैनिकांश्च समाहूय सुतीक्ष्णां वाचमूचतुः ॥

meaning.en: Then, stern in command, they set out to conquer the whole earth, and calling their soldiers they spoke sharp words.

verses.text:
राजर्षयो महायज्ञैर्हव्यकव्यैर्द्विजातयः ।
तेजो बलं च देवानां वर्धयन्ति श्रियं तथा ॥

meaning.en: Royal sages and twice-born Brahmins increase the strength, the glory and the splendor of the gods with great sacrifices and with offerings to gods and ancestors.

verses.text:
तेषामेवं प्रवृद्धानां सर्वेषामसुरद्विषाम् ।
संभूय सर्वैरस्माभिः कार्यः सर्वात्मना वधः ॥

meaning.en: Since all these enemies of the asuras grow strong in this way, all of us together must destroy them with our whole effort.

verses.text:
एवं सर्वान्समादिश्य पूर्वतीरे महोदधेः ।
क्रूरां मतिं समास्थाय जग्मतुः सर्वतोमुखम् ॥

meaning.en: Having thus instructed everyone, on the eastern shore of the great ocean they took up a cruel resolve and went forth in every direction.

verses.text:
यज्ञैर्यजन्ते ये केचिद्याजयन्ति च ये द्विजाः ।
तान्सर्वान्प्रसभं दृष्ट्वा बलिनौ जघ्नतुस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Any who performed sacrifices, and any Brahmins who conducted them, the two mighty ones seized by force and killed.

verses.text:
आश्रमेष्वग्निहोत्राणि ऋषीणां भावितात्मनाम् ।
गृहीत्वा प्रक्षिपन्त्यप्सु विश्रब्धाः सैनिकास्तयोः ॥

meaning.en: In the hermitages they took the sacred fires of the sages of purified spirit, and their soldiers unafraid threw them into the water.

verses.text:
तपोधनैश्च ये शापाः क्रुद्धैरुक्ता महात्मभिः ।
नाक्रामन्ति तयोस्तेऽपि वरदानेन जृम्भतोः ॥

meaning.en: Even the curses spoken in anger by great-souled ascetics did not touch the two, swollen with the power of their boon.

verses.text:
नाक्रामन्ति यदा शापा बाणा मुक्ताः शिलास्विव ।
नियमांस्तदा परित्यज्य व्यद्रवन्त द्विजातयः ॥

meaning.en: When the curses did not take effect, like arrows loosed at rock, the Brahmins abandoned their observances and fled.

verses.text:
पृथिव्यां ये तपःसिद्धा दान्ताः शमपरायणाः ।
तयोर्भयाद्दुद्रुवुस्ते वैनतेयादिवोरगाः ॥

meaning.en: Those on earth who had won perfection by austerity, self-controlled and devoted to peace, fled in fear of the two, like snakes from Garuda.

verses.text:
मथितैराश्रमैर्भग्नैर्विकीर्णकलशस्रुवैः ।
शून्यमासीज्जगत्सर्वं कालेनेव हतं यथा ॥

meaning.en: With hermitages smashed and broken, and ladles and pots scattered, the whole world became empty, as if struck down by Time.

verses.text:
राजर्षिभिरदृश्यद्भिरृषिभिश्च महासुरौ ।
उभौ विनिश्चयं कृत्वा विकुर्वाते वधैषिणौ ॥

meaning.en: With royal sages and sages hidden from sight, the two great asuras made up their minds and, bent on killing, took on new shapes.

verses.text:
प्रभिन्नकरटौ मत्तौ भूत्वा कुञ्जररूपिणौ ।
संलीनानपि दुर्गेषु निन्यतुर्यमसादनम् ॥

meaning.en: Becoming rutting elephants with temples split by rut, they sought out even those hidden in fortresses and sent them to the abode of Yama.

verses.text:
सिंहौ भूत्वा पुनर्व्याघ्रौ पुनश्चान्तर्हितावुभौ ।
तैस्तैरुपायैस्तौ क्रूरावृषीन्दृष्ट्वा निजघ्नतुः ॥

meaning.en: They became lions, then tigers, then disappeared again; by these and other means the cruel pair saw the sages and killed them.

verses.text:
निवृत्तयज्ञस्वाध्याया प्रणष्टनृपतिद्विजा ।
उत्सन्नोत्सवयज्ञा च बभूव वसुधा तदा ॥

meaning.en: With sacrifice and Vedic study stopped, with kings and Brahmins destroyed, and festivals and sacrifices ruined, the earth became so.

verses.text:
हाहाभूता भयार्ता च निवृत्तविपणापणा ।
निवृत्तदेवकार्या च पुण्योद्वाहविवर्जिता ॥

meaning.en: It was filled with cries of woe and full of fear, with trade and markets halted, divine rites abandoned and holy marriages gone.

verses.text:
निवृत्तकृषिगोरक्षा विध्वस्तनगराश्रमा ।
अस्थिकङ्कालसंकीर्णा भूर्बभूवोग्रदर्शना ॥

meaning.en: With farming and cattle-tending ended, cities and hermitages wrecked, and strewn with bones and skeletons, the earth looked terrible.

verses.text:
निवृत्तपितृकार्यं च निर्वषट्कारमङ्गलम् ।
जगत्प्रतिभयाकारं दुष्प्रेक्ष्यमभवत्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Rites for the ancestors ceased, the vashat call and all auspicious acts were gone, and the world became fearful in appearance and dreadful to behold.

verses.text:
चन्द्रादित्यौ ग्रहास्तारा नक्षत्राणि दिवौकसः ।
जग्मुर्विषादं तत्कर्म दृष्ट्वा सुन्दोपसुन्दयोः ॥

meaning.en: The moon and sun, the planets, the stars, the constellations and the dwellers in heaven were all filled with dejection at the deeds of Sunda and Upasunda.

verses.text:
एवं सर्वा दिशो दैत्यौ जित्वा क्रूरेण कर्मणा ।
निःसपत्नौ कुरुक्षेत्रे निवेशमभिचक्रतुः ॥

meaning.en: Having conquered all quarters by cruel deeds in this way, the two Daityas, with no rival left, made their camp at Kurukshetra.
